test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error. **

options.text: Protest is also a saffety valve.
Protest is also a safety valvve.
Protast is also a safety valve.
Protest is also a safety valve.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence with no spelling error is** option 4**: **"Protest is also a safety valve."**
 
• In this sentence, all words are spelled correctly according to English language standards:
 
 
• **"Protest" -** means a statement or action expressing disapproval of or objection to something.
 
• **"is" -** is the third person singular present of "be".
 
• **"also" - **means in addition or too.
 
• **"a" -** is an indefinite article used before words that start with a consonant sound.
 
• **"safety" -** means the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.
 
• **"valve" -** is a device for controlling the passage of fluid through a pipe or duct, especially an automatic device allowing movement in one direction only.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: ***'Protest is also a safety valve.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other sentences all contain at least one word that is misspelled:
 
 
• **"saffety"** should be "safety".
 
• **"valvve" **should be "valve".
 
• **"Protast"** should be "Protest".
